about: Tinybar Local's model registry: one entry per model the gateway may serve or pull. Ported from Draftbook's services/models/catalogue.json (17 November 2026), whose MLX proof (draftbook-in docs/initiatives/003-model-platform/mlx-proof.md) set the capabilities and memory budgets. A model not listed here cannot be served or pulled.
memoryNote: memoryBudgetTotalMb bounds every loaded worker together, counted by each entry's memory.budgetMb; the gateway evicts least-recently-used idle unpinned workers to fit, else answers 503. Each worker holds its budget against its process's physical footprint (Metal buffers included). cacheLimitMb caps MLX's buffer cache within a request; clearCacheAfterRequest returns it after each.

workKinds.read-page: page image in, the page's text out
workKinds.check-reading: page or region image plus a reading in, a judgement of that reading out
workKinds.extract-fields: page text and/or image plus a JSON schema in, fields out
workKinds.chat: messages in, a chat reply out

serverKinds.mlx-vlm: mlx-vlm's own OpenAI-compatible server (tinybar_models.mlx_server: three routes behind the gate), one process per model
serverKinds.jev-wrapper: tinybar_models.jev_server: the Jev classifier behind /v1/chat/completions; one page and its blocks in, {"scores": [{block, score}]} out
serverKinds.nemotron-wrapper: tinybar_models.nemotron_server: Nemotron's fixed-prompt reader, its tagged output parsed into {text, blocks}

licenceRule: Each weights source records its licence: id, commercialUse (allowed | not_allowed | unread) and where it was read. Real use is refused unless the source actually served is 'allowed'.
availabilityNote: A model serves requests only while it is available: availableByDefault per entry, else defaults.availableByDefault (false: a new entry serves nothing until turned on), unless the owner turned it on or off (POST /api/models/<name>/available, kept in availability.json in the state folder). Availability loads nothing by itself.
